evaluations.reason: [REQ:R1] is implemented by `FreshnessSourcePolicy` named `freshness-source`, exported as `FRESHNESS_SOURCE_POLICY`, with directory-name exclusions for `.git`, `.senti`, `node_modules`, and `vendor`, plus repository-relative exclusions for `specs/*/review-history`, `specs/*/review-evidence`, and `specs/*/tests/.raw` while otherwise returning true for traversable paths. The implementation keeps this in `src/lib/file-tree-walker.js` as a dedicated class, uses only built-in modules, and the mapped execution evidence passed the surface test covering excluded generated/runtime boundaries before file budget consumption. [EVIDENCE:R1] [TEST:R1] [TEST-REVIEW]

evaluations.reason: [REQ:R2] requires the freshness source policy to apply only to sourceRoot traversal, docs/ traversal to run without source exclusions, and either scan to return indeterminate on traversal bounds or unreadable included paths. [EVIDENCE:R2] shows source traversal calls newestMtime(srcRoot, policy, sourcePolicy, sourceDocsDirectory) while docs traversal calls newestMtime(docsDir, policy), so docs uses the default scan policy without freshness exclusions. [EVIDENCE:R2] also preserves ScanPolicy bounds through DEFAULT_SCAN_POLICY and collects traversal.limits plus unreadable stat failures as TraversalLimit("unreadable", ...), with checkFreshness returning FreshnessResult("indeterminate") when either scan is incomplete, satisfying [CONSTRAINT:2]. [TEST:R2] validates the required fail-closed behavior for non-excluded source and documentation limits, and [TEST-REVIEW] reports pass.
evaluations.title: R2

evaluations.reason: [REQ:R3] requires sourceScan and docsScan JSON details with target, policy name, complete, and limits containing kind, relativePath, and maximum, while preserving result names and toText labels. [EVIDENCE:R3] adds FreshnessScan as a dedicated class, serializes target/policy/complete/limits with the required limit fields, wires sourceScan and docsScan into FreshnessResult.toJSON(), preserves FRESHNESS_RESULTS names, and keeps existing text behavior while mapping indeterminate limits through describeLimits(). [TEST:R3] validates the source and documentation scan details are exposed without changing result labels, and [TEST-REVIEW] confirms the test result review passed.
evaluations.title: R3

evaluations.reason: [REQ:R4] requires tests proving excluded .senti, node_modules, vendor, .git, and generated specs evidence can exceed maxFiles while freshness still resolves fresh or stale, plus separate proof that non-excluded source or docs limits return indeterminate. [EVIDENCE:R4] adds tests/unit/check/scan-freshness.test.js coverage where all named excluded directories contain 3 files under maxFiles:2 and the result remains fresh, with no sourceScan limits; it also retains/extends an indeterminate assertion for non-excluded source maxFiles. [EVIDENCE:R4] also adds specs/480-freshness-scan-policy/tests/freshness-source-surface.test.js cases proving excluded generated/runtime boundaries over the production maxFiles limit still allow stale, and that non-excluded source and docs limits return indeterminate. [TEST:R4] and [TEST-REVIEW] provide validated passing execution evidence for the mapped spec test, while [REGRESSION] correctly defers full-project regression to final-regression.
